description: This source file implements a development runner for Pipecat bots, supporting multiple transport types such as WebRTC, Daily, and telephony (Twilio, Telnyx, etc.). It sets up a FastAPI server with various routes for WebRTC, webhook handling, and telephony WebSocket connections, and includes command-line interface for configuration. It also contains logic for direct Daily connections and environment setup.

classes.name: IceServer
classes.description: TypedDict for ICE server configuration in WebRTC setup

classes.name: IceConfig
classes.description: TypedDict for ICE configuration including ICE servers

classes.name: StartBotResult
classes.description: TypedDict for the response of WebRTC start endpoint

methods.name: _get_bot_module
methods.description: Discovers and returns the module containing the 'bot' function from the main script or current directory.

methods.name: _run_telephony_bot
methods.description: Runs a bot for telephony transports passing the WebSocket connection.

methods.name: _create_server_app
methods.description: Creates a FastAPI app with routes configured for specific transport types.

methods.name: _setup_webrtc_routes
methods.description: Sets up WebRTC-specific routes including offer handling, file download, and session management.

methods.name: _setup_whatsapp_routes
methods.description: Configures WhatsApp webhook verification and message handling routes.

methods.name: _setup_daily_routes
methods.description: Configures Daily-specific routes including room creation, webhook handling, and dial-in support.

methods.name: _setup_telephony_routes
methods.description: Configures telephony webhook and WebSocket routes for Twilio, Telnyx, Plivo, Exotel.

methods.name: _run_daily_direct
methods.description: Runs a Daily bot directly without starting a FastAPI server.

methods.name: _validate_and_clean_proxy
methods.description: Validates and cleans proxy hostname, removing protocols and trailing slashes.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for the script; parses CLI arguments, configures environment, and starts the server or direct connection.
